CustomField.description: The settings the installed entity processor ran the last dry run under, as a document only that processor reads (for Giving, donation matching's behaviour, date window and amount tolerance). The commit runs under them rather than the template's values as they stand then, so it does what the dry run showed (R-IB11).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The settings the last dry run used. The commit uses the same ones.
CustomField.label: Processor Settings
